_comment: Pre-vetted local models for Solstone. The Ollama backend was removed upstream (PR #44), so the former ollama-local/ rows have been dropped. The remaining vllm-local/ rows are retained while vLLM is still a peer; they will be replaced by bundled llama.cpp local/ rows when the benchmark harness is reworked to target the local provider (follow-up to the Phase A Spark pin). Benchmarks are measured tok/s per canonical hardware class (see reference.json) and are populated via solstone.think.benchmark.harness on real hardware. An empty benchmarks dict means no measurement is available yet — the estimator falls back to confidence=unknown. Multimodal-omni entries (text+image+audio) report a single output_tok_s tied to text generation plus optional vision_output_tok_s / audio_output_tok_s supplementary fields when measured separately; per-task timings under tasks.<task_id> capture each modality individually.

vllm-local/qwen3.5:35b-a3b.label: Qwen 3.5 35B (A3B, bf16) — vLLM-served (comparison entry)
vllm-local/qwen3.5:35b-a3b.notes: vLLM-served counterpart of ollama-local/qwen3.5:35b-a3b-bf16 (PRO-tier promotable). Same bf16 quant; the HF repo is multimodal but only the text path is exercised. capabilities=['generate'] (cogitate works mechanically per Phase 5 cogitate validation but not yet wired into tier defaults). Production-routable as VLLM_PRO via journal contexts. Watch item: NVFP4 + Qwen MoE on Blackwell (incl. Spark GB10) has known vLLM gibberish-output issues — we serve at bf16 to dodge this entirely; do not switch to NVFP4 quant without testing. See Transient/vLLM vs Ollama Comparison.md for the broader picture.

vllm-local/qwen2.5vl:7b-awq.label: Qwen 2.5 VL 7B (AWQ-Int4) — vLLM-served (comparison entry)
vllm-local/qwen2.5vl:7b-awq.notes: vLLM-served counterpart of ollama-local/qwen2.5vl:7b. Uses AWQ-Int4 (closest to Ollama default Q4_K_M); the bf16 variant of this model on vLLM is ~3x slower on Spark due to memory bandwidth, so AWQ is the production-realistic comparison. Not currently wired into a tier default but routable via journal contexts. See Transient/vLLM vs Ollama Comparison.md for the broader picture.

vllm-local/qwen3.5:9b-awq.label: Qwen 3.5 9B (AWQ-Int4) — vLLM-served (FLASH-tier promotable)
vllm-local/qwen3.5:9b-awq.notes: vLLM-served counterpart of ollama-local/qwen3.5:9b. AWQ-Int4 from cyankiwi (de-facto community Qwen quantizer; Qwen team recommends his quants on Qwen3-Next official cards) chosen as the apples-to-apples match for Ollama default Q4_K_M. Production-routable as VLLM_FLASH via journal contexts. Caveat: kaitchup benchmarks observed up to 33% accuracy drop on reasoning tasks for quantized 9B variants when thinking is enabled (model thinks more, hits max-output-tokens, returns truncated answers). Sanity-check output quality before enabling thinking on FLASH-tier vLLM calls; AWQ regeneration recipe in ~/solstone-vllm-spike/AWQ_RECIPE.md.

vllm-local/qwen3.5:2b-awq.label: Qwen 3.5 2B (AWQ-Int4) — vLLM-served (LITE-tier promotable)
vllm-local/qwen3.5:2b-awq.notes: vLLM-served counterpart of ollama-local/qwen3.5:2b. AWQ-Int4 from cyankiwi for apples-to-apples with Ollama Q4_K_M. Production-routable as VLLM_LITE via journal contexts. Notably faster than the Ollama equivalent on Spark (98 vs 87 tok/s synthetic; 0.87 vs 1.37s chat_reply) — at this size class vLLM kernels seem to have a real advantage over Ollama. AWQ regeneration recipe in ~/solstone-vllm-spike/AWQ_RECIPE.md.

vllm-local/nemotron-omni.label: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B (NVFP4) — omni (text+image+audio+video)
vllm-local/nemotron-omni.notes: Served via vLLM 0.20.0 (upstream vllm/vllm-openai container) on Spark; HF: nvidia/Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning-NVFP4. First multimodal-omni entry in the registry — unifies what previously took qwen3.5 (text/cogitate) + qwen2.5vl (vision) + Whisper/Parakeet (audio) into one model. Capabilities list intentionally omits 'cogitate' (vLLM-via-OpenCode unverified, deferred) and 'video' (Solstone's video pipeline still does frame-extraction — unified video is a separate design pass).
